PROJECT STUDY / 01

Civil tender documentation generator

A source-code study of a proposed Revit-to-PDF documentation workflow.

The task

Combine repeated drawing preparation steps with material reporting in one Dynamo CPython script. The supplied source targets an existing Revit model; it does not create the silos, buildings, or pipe network.

The supplied implementation

The script collects selected model categories, groups reported values by material, creates plan, elevation, and section views, places those views on sheets, and requests a combined PDF export.

The workflow matrix

The accompanying workbook maps fourteen stages: document context, grids, levels, foundations, columns, framing, silo shells, slabs, piping, views and sheets, styling, dimensions, material quantities, and PDF export. Its geometry and load values are proposed assumptions. Model-creation stages extend beyond the supplied script.

What still needs verification

  • Material-specific quantities and separate units for volume and length.
  • Model extents, section orientation, elevation directions, and a suitable plan view for elevation creation.
  • Grid references, dimension placement, title block size, and unique sheet numbering.
  • Revit version compatibility, transaction handling, and a successful export against a real model.
